sources.entry: SubEthaEdit - General purpose plain text editor for macOS. Widely known for its live collaboration feature.

summary.one_liner: SubEthaEdit is a general-purpose plain-text editor for macOS, widely known for its live collaboration feature.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SubEthaEdit as a general-purpose plain-text editor for macOS, known for live collaboration. It explains that this GitHub repository is the main development repository, while the official releases (in and out of the Mac App Store) are based on subethaedit.net. The README's development setup covers cloning the repo, switching to the develop branch, initializing git submodules, and editing BuildConfig/Identity.xcconfig with a team ID, product name, and bundle identifier base before opening SubEthaEdit.xcworkspace in Xcode. It also links related repositories for TCMPortMapper.framework, ObjectiveTOML (tomlutil), and a Sparkle branch. The README does not describe editing features in detail.
use_cases: contributing to a macOS Objective-C app
general-purpose note or code text editing
how_to_run: git clone the repository and switch to the develop branch
Edit BuildConfig/Identity.xcconfig with your Apple team ID, product name, and CFBundleIdentifier base (use `security find-identity -v` to find your Team ID)
Open SubEthaEdit.xcworkspace and build the app in Xcode
notable: Live collaborative editing, the feature the project is best known for
Official releases are distributed via subethaedit.net, both inside and outside the Mac App Store
Uses the Jupiter project's transactional transformations for collaboration, per the acknowledgments
Includes a Sparkle-based update framework built from a specific branch
caveats: Development requires the most recent macOS and an Apple developer account
Build setup requires personal team ID and bundle identifier configuration
README does not describe a feature list or user documentation beyond the one-line description
